_meta.purpose: Registry of every static canonicalOverride value used in MDG franchise/guide/blog pages. Edit this file when adding a new canonical mapping — no .astro change required for the registry entry itself. The Migration Status field tells the run-time whether each row is the literal source-of-truth (migrated) or just an advertised target for in-progress consolidation (migrate-pending).
_meta.shape: Object keyed by stable source-page slug (e.g. 'blog/recreational-cannabis-near-acadia'). Each value is { 'target': 'absolute URL the page consolidates to', 'rationale': 'one-sentence reason for the consolidation', 'migrated': 'YYYY-MM-DD | no', 'sha256[0:16]': 'first 16 chars of the sha256 of the file at migrate time; recompute when target changes.' }
_meta.unsupported_shapes: Pages that derive their canonicalOverride from a runtime computation (e.g. all-cities.astro: {canonicalUrl} from frontmatter) DO NOT appear here. This registry covers only static literals. If you find yourself wanting a runtime override with multiple conditional targets, surface it in a Hub entry and discuss before adding a registry shape for it.
